scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @cornicione/server" "npm run dev -w @cornicione/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cornicione/server && npm run build -w @cornicione/client
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run start -w @cornicione/server" "npm run start -w @cornicione/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cornicione/server && npm run typecheck -w @cornicione/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @cornicione/server && npm run lint -w @cornicione/client
